prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the claim referenced above. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm receipt of this request in writing.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, dashcam or surveillance footage from the parking facility, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any other materials in your possession or control. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt response.
